TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Empire of Men Faction.

Translations.Comment: 帝国 = empire. Conveys grand, multi-kingdom nature of human civilization.
皇帝 = imperial, 剣士 = swordsman. Elite imperial infantry.
歩兵 = foot soldier/infantry. Knights fighting on foot rather than mounted.
戟兵 = halberdier/pole-arm warrior. Professional halberd-wielding troops.
槍兵 = spearman. Standard military formation with pike discipline.
騎士 = knight. Heavy cavalry elite of the empire.
軽騎兵 = light cavalry. Scouts and skirmishers.
弓兵 = archer. Classic ranged infantry.
弩兵 = crossbowman. More powerful ranged troops than archers.
銃兵 = gunner/musketeer. Renaissance-era firearm specialists.
砲 = cannon. Heavy artillery with destructive power.
迫撃砲 = mortar. Indirect fire artillery weapon.
巨体兵器 = colossal war machine. Massive mechanical dreadnought.
グリフォン = gryphon (katakana). Majestic imperial symbol of power.
皇帝の竜 = imperial dragon. Ultimate flying unit under imperial control.
隊長 = captain/commander. Battle-hardened military leader.
騎士団長 = knight commander. Leader of knightly military orders.
魔術師 = wizard/sorcerer. Magic user serving the empire.
